title: Bounded JSON request deadlines
summary: JSON clients share one absolute deadline across DNS, connect, send, headers and body. Expired operations report a deadline failure, including when urllib wraps a connect or send deadline in URLError; genuine connection refusals remain network failures. This applies to private HTTP and HTTPS, replay-safe reads and caller-owned mutations on every OS. HTTPS functions called inside Doctor checks share the active check deadline and spend at most two attempts including retry delays, so install-readiness registry failures cannot consume the ordinary relay retry schedule.
